title: ScanReport
description: Returned by quick_scan_command on completion. Summarises the results of one full scan cycle including orphan detection.

books_added.description: Number of new book records inserted into the database during this scan.

books_skipped.description: Number of directories skipped because a record with the same album title already exists in the database.

books_newly_orphaned.description: Number of existing book records whose resolved file path no longer exists on disk. These records have been set to orphaned=true.

errors.description: Number of files or directories that could not be processed (corrupt tags, permission denied, etc.). A warning was logged for each.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock time for the complete scan cycle (traversal + parallel metadata extraction + DB writes + orphan check), in milliseconds.
